questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Heterophyes heterophyes?
options: Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
questions.explanation: Embryonated eggs in stool. Concentrated stool wet mounts at 400×; species confirmation may need adults or molecular methods.
